framework: Canonical Asbab-e-Sittah Zarooriyyah (The Six Essential Requisites of Life)
classical_precept: Equilibrium of health (Sihhat) is maintained when the six essential external factors are aligned with an individual's innate temperament (Mizaj-e-Asli). Deviation precipitates qualitative or quantitative humoral dyscrasia (Su-e-Mizaj).
authorities: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Zakariya al-Razi (Kitab al-Hawi)

factors.physiological_action: Provides essential coolness (Tanfeeth) to the innate heat (Hararat-e-Ghariziyyah), purifies the vital spirit (Rooh-e-Hayawani), and expels fuliginous metabolic vapors (Dukhan).

seasonal_considerations.spring_rabee: Moderate; activates accumulated winter humors; moderate venesection (Fasd) or cleansing indicated if plethoric.
seasonal_considerations.summer_saif: Hot & Dry; depletes moisture and innate heat; requires cool, moist environments and hydration.
seasonal_considerations.autumn_khareef: Cold & Dry; produces morbid melancholic humors; requires humidifying regimens.
seasonal_considerations.winter_shita: Cold & Moist; thickens phlegm; necessitates warming spices and moderate physical exertion.

temperamental_prescriptions.damawi: Well-ventilated, moderately cool, low-humidity spaces. Avoid stifling heat.
temperamental_prescriptions.safrawi: Cool, shaded, adequately humidified ambient air. Avoid direct solar radiation.
temperamental_prescriptions.balghami: Warm, dry, well-sunlit environments. Avoid damp basements and chilling drafts.
temperamental_prescriptions.saudawi: Warm, moderately humid rooms with natural airflow. Avoid arid, windy atmospheres.

factors.physiological_action: Substrates for metabolic transformation through four stages of digestion: Gastric (Hazm-e-Meda), Hepatic (Hazm-e-Kabid), Vascular (Hazm-e-Urooq), and Cellular (Hazm-e-Uzw).

dietary_classes.ghiza_e_lateef: Light, easily digestible nourishment producing subtle, clear humors (e.g., barley water, pomegranate broth, tender chicken soup).
dietary_classes.ghiza_e_kaseef: Dense, heavy nourishment producing substantial, viscous humors (e.g., beef, lentils, aged cheese, heavy tubers).
dietary_classes.ghiza_e_muatadil: Balanced staple nourishment maintaining humoral equilibrium (e.g., whole wheat, zucchini, bottle gourd, sweet apples).

temperamental_prescriptions.damawi: Hypocaloric, cooling foods: Cucumbers, pomegranates, barley water, leafy greens. Reduce red meat and saturated fats.
temperamental_prescriptions.safrawi: Cooling and hydrating foods: Isabgol, melons, coriander, curd, tamarind drink. Restrict chilies, garlic, and fried dishes.
temperamental_prescriptions.balghami: Warming and drying foods: Fenugreek, cumin, ginger, black pepper, mutton soup. Strictly restrict dairy, cold sweets, and excess water.
temperamental_prescriptions.saudawi: Warm and moistening foods: Almond milk, mutton broth, figs, raisins, olive oil. Strictly avoid dry lentils, cabbage, and stale food.

factors.physiological_action: Ignites innate heat (Hararat-e-Ghariziyyah), accelerates perspiration, enhances tissue perfusion, and facilitates elimination of metabolic waste (Fuzlaat).

intensity_guidelines.riyazat_e_muatadilah: Moderate exercise until skin turns flushed, breath slightly quickens, and light perspiration appears. Discontinue before exhaustion.
intensity_guidelines.riyazat_e_shadeedah: Excessive vigorous movement; consumes innate moisture (Rutoobat-e-Ghariziyyah) and causes premature senescence.
intensity_guidelines.sukoon_e_mufrit: Sedentary inertia; causes accumulation of raw humor (Khilt-e-Kham) and metabolic sluggishness.

temperamental_prescriptions.damawi: Regular aerobic exercise (brisk walking, swimming) to consume metabolic plethora.
temperamental_prescriptions.safrawi: Gentle, non-heating movement (stretching, evening walks, calming yoga). Avoid midday workouts.
temperamental_prescriptions.balghami: Vigorous, stimulating exercise in warm environments to burn cold-moist phlegmatic buildup.
temperamental_prescriptions.saudawi: Mild, rhythmically restorative movement. Avoid exhausting endurance routines.

factors.physiological_action: Sudden emotional changes cause movement of the vital spirit (Rooh): outward expansion in anger (Ghadab) and joy (Farah), or inward retreat in fear (Khauf) and grief (Huzn).

psychosomatic_pathways.ghadab: Extreme anger rapidly disperses Rooh outwards, heating the temperament to acute bile formation.
psychosomatic_pathways.huzn: Deep chronic grief retreats Rooh into the cardiac core, chilling the body and producing combusted black bile (Sauda).
psychosomatic_pathways.surur_e_muatadil: Moderate joy and tranquility strengthens cardiac faculty (Quwwat-e-Qalbiyyah) and sustains homeostasis.

temperamental_prescriptions.damawi: Stress de-escalation, meditation, avoiding over-stimulating social agitation.
temperamental_prescriptions.safrawi: Cooling aromatherapy (Rose, Sandalwood, Camphor), breathwork, emotional pacification.
temperamental_prescriptions.balghami: Stimulating mental puzzles, social engagement, uplifting environments, avoiding lethargy.
temperamental_prescriptions.saudawi: Compassionate psychotherapy, gentle companionship, serene music, natural green landscapes.

factors.physiological_action: Sleep directs the innate heat inward to perfect digestion and cell repair. Prolonged wakefulness disperses heat, drying tissues and provoking neuro-cognitive strain.

circadian_recommendations.optimal_duration: 6 to 8 hours nocturnal sleep tailored to personal constitution.
circadian_recommendations.posture: Begin lying on the right side for 15 minutes to settle gastric contents toward the pylorus, then turn to the left to facilitate hepatic warmth over the stomach.
circadian_recommendations.daytime_nap_qailulah: Permissible for 20-30 minutes before midday meal in summer; contraindicated in cold-moist seasons.

temperamental_prescriptions.damawi: Standard 7-8 hours restful sleep. Avoid sleeping immediately post heavy dinners.
temperamental_prescriptions.safrawi: Requires restorative 7.5-8.5 hours to replenish moisture lost to bilious dry heat.
temperamental_prescriptions.balghami: Limit sleep to 6-7 hours. Avoid daytime slumber to prevent phlegm excess.
temperamental_prescriptions.saudawi: Prioritize deep sleep 8 hours with unhurried bedtime wind-down to counter melancholy dryness.

factors.physiological_action: Retention preserves essential vital fluids (semen, moisture, digestive secretions). Evacuation eliminates toxic waste products (sweat, urine, feces, menses, sputum).

pathological_deviations.ehtibas_e_maddi: Morbid retention (constipation, oliguria, amenorrhea) poisoning internal organ axes.
pathological_deviations.istifragh_e_mufrit: Excessive depletion (profuse diarrhea, emesis, hemorrhage) collapsing innate vigor.

temperamental_prescriptions.damawi: Ensure daily bowel elimination; seasonal mild venesection or cupping (Hijama) if blood pressure elevates.
temperamental_prescriptions.safrawi: Hydration to promote clear diuresis and gentle biliary elimination using mild laxatives (Mullayin).
temperamental_prescriptions.balghami: Diaphoretic steaming (Hammam), expectoration clearance, and gentle lymphatic drainage.
temperamental_prescriptions.saudawi: Avoid obstinate constipation via psyllium seed husk, almond oil, and warm mineral water.
